summary: Foster an AI-ready organizational culture with our expert training. Enhance collaboration and drive success in a rapidly changing technological environment.
lede: Building an AI-Ready Organizational Culture helps professionals shape the behaviors, routines, and decision rights that support trusted AI adoption. The course covers readiness assessment, role-based AI literacy, manager sponsorship, psychological safety, and responsible use across functions. You will practice readiness mapping, manager enablement, policy translation, culture dashboard construction, and roadmap development. The training also shows how NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and practical change management methods can inform governance, learning, and reporting without becoming a technical AI implementation program.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to shape how people adopt AI across the organization, not just how tools are deployed.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, reliable internet access, and working access to common office software for workshops and template completion. Bring any current AI policy, workforce learning plan, change roadmap, or adoption metrics you already use. No programming environment or data science software is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
